prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create a high quality dark mythic naturalistic fantasy creature DESIGN CONTACT SHEET for Witch, species dormouse. SIX clearly separated equal panels in THREE COLUMNS and TWO ROWS. Column A, B, C are THREE DISTINCT concepts below. TOP ROW: low near-ground heroic environmental view, whole giant clearly framed. BOTTOM ROW: SAME A/B/C designs respectively at actual-game-camera approximation: looking down29.79degrees, body turned34.38degrees toward camera from side, affine/isometric-looking, whole creature visible. No lettering, no labels, no UI. Strong coherent silhouettes, richly tactile fur/weathered materials, moonlit forest palette with selective magic light.
EVERY ONE OF SIX PANELS must show a small modern young adult WITCH standing on ground BESIDE giant: pointed floppy olive hat, headphones, jeans, sneakers, broom, warm lantern. Also several actual FOREST TREES at same ground plane around giant as unmistakable scale rulers. Creature anatomical height is COLOSSAL, above surrounding mature treetops, about20times its species baby height as design intent. Witch is tiny beside it; never same-size character portrait, never merely ordinary animal. Trees have discernible trunks/crowns. Atmospheric depth for distant body, massive heavy landform wear, ancient ecology. Don't hide animal face beneath vegetation or effects. Scale cues are mandatory in bottom game-camera row too. Distinct signatures, not common royal crown uniform.
Area story from actual source: Honeysuckle tangle: grass and clover, bramble walls, honeysuckle, hazel coppice..
Column A: Winter Sanctuary: giant golden hazel dormouse round ears/dark half-open eyes/furredtail, curled in an opened hazelnut shell like a weathered amphitheatre; warm dream glow, visible paws/head/body, honeysuckle/hazel groves outside shell and offerings at lip.
Column B: Honeysuckle Dream Weaver: colossal dormouse with soft golden mass, round ears/eyes and long furred tail, enormous grasping paws weave living honeysuckle arches between hazel trees, silver whiskers carry sleeping seed lights, weathered nest shawl with tiny votive bells.
Column C: MAXIMUM FANTASY Sleeper Between Ages: colossal recognisable golden DORMOUSE, roundears/dark sleepy eyes/furredtail; an immense open cracked hazelnut shell contains a deep starfield dream while the animal remains materially visible resting at its rim, tail wraps shell as wooded valley, ancient hazel grove grows across old shell and silver fur scars; tiny offered nuts/shrines. Not a squirrel or naked mouse tail.
Species must be identifiable at a glance from anatomy, not labels. No extra legs or fused witch/animal. Echo concept-specific anatomy/material/signature faithfully between top and bottom rows. Old/powerful/revered not cute baby. This is concept art, not runtime screenshot; no numerical scale labels.
